title: Beyond Single-Attribute Auditing: A Configurable Multi-Attribute Benchmark for Intersectional Fairness in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.35069v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated for fairness, yet most existing benchmarks audit one sensitive attribute at a time. This single-attribute paradigm can miss intersectional harms, where multiple attributes interact non-additively and produce failures that are invisible under marginal evaluation. We introduce ComFair, a configurable benchmark that converts existing fairness data into 479,066 controlled Dual- and Multi-attribute instances and pairs every augmented instance with its task-equivalent source. Across Recognition, Selection, Continuation, and Conversation, this pairing supports a unified audit of performance or bias-score shifts, how often added attributes introduce new errors or mask existing ones, and model-ranking stability. Experiments on ten LLMs show task- and subgroup-dependent sensitivity: discriminative tasks expose both transition directions even when aggregate changes are modest, generative tasks

translated_title: 超越单属性审计：一个面向大语言模型交叉性公平的可配置多属性基准
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的公平性评估日益受到关注，然而现有的大多数基准一次仅审计一个敏感属性。这种单属性范式可能遗漏交叉性伤害，即多个属性以非相加的方式相互作用，产生在边际评估下不可见的模型失败。我们提出了ComFair，这是一个可配置的基准，它将现有的公平性数据转换为479,066个受控的双属性和多属性实例，并将每个增强实例与其任务等效的源实例配对。在识别、选择、续写和对话四类任务中，这种配对设计支持对以下方面进行统一审计：性能或偏见分数的变化、新增属性引入新错误或掩盖既有错误的频率，以及模型排名的稳定性。对十个大语言模型的实验表明，其敏感性依赖于任务类型和子群体：判别式任务即使在总体变化不大时也能暴露两个方向的转变，而生成式任务……
tldr: 提出可配置的多属性公平性审计基准ComFair，将现有公平性数据转化为约48万个受控的双/多属性实例并与任务等效源实例配对，从而能统一检测单属性审计无法发现的交叉性公平伤害。
en_tdlr: We introduce ComFair, a configurable benchmark that converts existing fairness data into 479,066 controlled dual- and multi-attribute instances paired with task-equivalent sources, enabling unified auditing of intersectional fairness harms that single-attribute evaluation fails to detect.
